title: YETI Rambler 8 oz Stackable Cup, Stainless Steel, Vacuum Insulated Espresso Cup with MagSlider Lid, Seafoam

reviews.title: Would buy again (but hopefully wont have to)
reviews.body: So I’m writing this in 2024 where it is now deemed reasonable to spend 20 quid on a travel coffee mug that (if the last three mugs are anything to go by) will get lost within six monthsI was looking for something that was good quality and well designed but not so cool that it drifts into the overbearingingly pretentious hipster zone.  This feels like it sits in that Goldilocks niche.Dishwasher cleaning is a breeze thanks to the easily removable magnetic bitDrinks are kept tongue burning hot for a good whileThe ‘glass-like’ plastic lid is nice to drink fromIt says it isn’t leak proof though and that is right . Absolutely no putting this inside a bagThe 8oz size is cuteSo I’m hoping the price tag will be enough to ensure that I am subconsciously more careful and don’t lose this one
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 12 October 2024
reviews.author: The Drainage King

reviews.title: Perfect Espresso Cup
reviews.body: Excellent quality mug. Keeps espresso hot for much longer than a regular cup, feels very durable, and has a premium finish. The size is perfect for coffee lovers, and the stackable design is a nice bonus for saving space. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great tumbler, looks and feels great in hand
reviews.body: Love this tumbler. Great mini size for my daily commute. Smaller base, so fits in my cars cup holders (which struggle with larger tumblers). Keeps my drink warm. Obvious expect some leakage if turned upside down, but won't spill from normal use. Very aesthetic too.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 1 December 2025
reviews.author: Sunena Sharda

features: The Rambler 8 oz. Stackable Cup is designed with the home (or far from home) barista in mind. Start the ascent with an americano, hit the lakeshore with a latte, or conquer your commute with a cortado, it stacks up to how you perk up
BARISTA-FRIENDLY - Designed to fit most espresso machines and dishwasher safe because no one needs more work to do
18/8 STAINLESS STEEL - Made with kitchen-grade stainless steel so they’re puncture - and rust - resistant. They are also stackable for easy storage
DOUBLE-WALL VACUUM INSULATION - Keeps cold drinks cold and hot drinks hot to the last sip

MAGSLIDER LID - While the MagSlider Lid adds a barrier of protection for keeping drinks contained and preventing heat or cold from escaping, Please Note – The MagSlider Lid is not leak-proof and will not prevent spills
